سُلَّأءٌ The prickles of the palm-tree: [a coll. gen. n.:] n. un. with ة. (S, M, Msb, K.) ―
-b2- Also, (K,) or [correctly the n. un.] سُلَّآءَةٌ, (M,) A sort of arrow-head, or spear-head, (M, K, *) in shape like the prickle of the palm-tree: (M, K:) and سلاءة, app. [سِلَآءَةٌ] without teshdeed [and with kesr], occurs in a trad. in this sense; for it is said that its pl. is ↓ سِلَآءٌ , of the same measure as حِمَارٌ. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also A certain bird, (M, K,) dust-coloured, and long-legged. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
